pr_body:
Updates test to always have non-empty roles in autoscaling policy

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/67620
pr_comments: @benwtrent I muted this test as part of https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/67620 so you might want to update this branch from the latest changes on `master` and unmute.

issue_context.title: [CI] TransportPutAutoscalingPolicyActionIT testUpdatePolicy failing reproducibly

Yes.
